nonblocking_findings: C-P3-r2-1 [Nit] review-c: apps/www-reading-advantage/src/components/products/product-picture.tsx:25 gives each non-portrait picture the hint '(min-width: 1024px) 25vw, 100vw'. Phase 3 moved two pictures onto this hint, and both fill a larger part of the row. The hero column is lg:col-span-6 (page.tsx:192, picture at :194), about 44 to 45 percent of the viewport at 1024 to 1280 px. The Reedy column is lg:col-span-5 (page.tsx:289, picture at :291), about 34 to 37 percent. The phase base set 50vw for the hero and 40vw for Reedy (git show 81df01cf2, page.tsx lines 182 and 286). At lg and wider, the browser now picks a candidate about half as wide as the slot, so both pictures can look soft. The preload that priority adds carries the same hint. Found by code reading, git show of the phase base, and layout arithmetic from the class list, not in a browser. Fix: add an optional sizes prop to ProductPicture, and pass 50vw at lg for the hero and 40vw at lg for Reedy. These lines did not change in the remediation.

C-P3-r2-2 [Nit] review-c: apps/www-reading-advantage/src/components/marketing/tutor-commission-calculator.tsx:434-436 shows graph.legCommissionBar ('Commission of each leg', PR section 6) beside result.legPayouts, the sum of all legs. At preset 2 this row reads 8,010, while each leg row shows 4,005 (:399). The adversarial test pins the sum (tutor-commission-calculator.adversarial.test.tsx:350 and :363). With 2 or more legs the label says each leg and the figure is the total. The results card already names the same sum 'Leg commissions' (:214). Owner: the PR copy owner and the spec owner. Options: label this total with results.legCommissions, or use legCommissionBar for the per-leg figure. The remediation did not change these lines. Found by code reading and the pinned test values, not in a browser.

C-P3-r2-3 [Nit] review-c: apps/www-reading-advantage/src/app/[locale]/(marketing)/products/tutor-advantage/page.placeholders.test.tsx:76 checks only that a value exists (values[name] == null). A page call with { n: '1' } passes this test, but each leg row would then read 'Leg 1', because the component finds no '{n}' to replace (tutor-commission-calculator.tsx:393). Design rule 11 asks for the literal { n: '{n}' }. Add an assertion that the value for calculator.graph.legBar equals { n: '{n}' }. Found by code reading of the test, not by a mutation run.

C-P3-3 fixed: tutor-commission-calculator.tsx:163-171 skips the resize when the field text is empty. readLegCount (:186-187) uses the row count for Add leg (:191) and Remove leg (:196) while the field is empty. The test 'keeps the leg rows and the typed students when the field is cleared' passes. It types 5 and 7 in two rows, clears the count field, expects 2 rows, types 2, and expects 5 and 7 back. The old code gave 3 and 3 (round 1 module run: resizeLegs([5,7],0) gives [], then resizeLegs([],2) gives [3,3]).

C-P3-4 fixed: product-picture.tsx:8 adds an optional priority prop, and :23-24 pass priority and loading='eager'. page.tsx:194-198 sets priority for the hero. Next 16.4.1 get-img-props.js:306-313 throws only for priority with loading='lazy' and for preload with priority, so this pair is legal. Next 16.4.1 drops the loading attribute for priority alone, so the explicit eager value is needed for the test. The test 'AC-23: the hero image is the eager largest image' passes. The old lazy hero fails it.

A-P3-1 fixed: tutor-commission-calculator.tsx:415 shows result.ownVolume under graph.ownBar (12,000 for preset 1; 6,000 for presets 2 and 3, as pinned by 3 component tests). The bar widths at :405 and :421 use shareOfNetwork, so the own bar and the leg bars sum to 100 percent (adversarial test: 9000/24000 twice plus 6000/24000 for preset 2; 12000/42000 three times plus 6000/42000 for preset 3). The totals keep gross, leg commissions, and net: 12,655.69, 8,010, 4,506.32 and 24,833.45, 16,560, 8,025.25. The pre-tax figures 8,273.45 and 4,645.69 no longer show on screen.

PR section 3 line 123 parity: each leg row shows a bar, the leg volume (:396), and the leg commission (:399). The own students show as one bar (:413-421). The gross, the leg commissions, and the payout after leg commissions and 3 percent tax show as totals (:428-442). Spec D-9 and D-20 record the totals under the bars. Judgement: accepted, no finding.
